既是戏团「云翰社」的当家，也是璃月港内风头正劲的名角。

云堇唱腔甜美，扮相俏丽，以灵动又富有情感的表演闻名。无论是娇柔端庄的闺中千金，还是义薄云天的巾帼女杰，她都能拿捏得恰到好处。

更为难得的是，这位年轻演员还懂得剧本创作。除《神女劈观》外，云翰社近年来另有不少新剧，皆出自云堇之手。

不过，令人意外的是，向来以端庄优雅形象示人的云堇，还有个不为人知的小爱好——听摇滚。

若是在璃月港内的摇滚乐表演现场见到她，还请不要声张。

否则，她说不定又要挨长辈们唠叨啦。

「和裕茶馆」历来是璃月人工作之余的一大好去处。

和裕茶馆的生意之所以如此兴隆，一是老板范二爷经营得当，请的茶博士说起书来是一绝。

二是璃月知名的戏社「云翰社」正挂靠在此。云翰社如今的当家兼顶梁柱一名角云堇，有时会来登台开唱。

美味的小吃也好，说书人的故事也好，只要去对地方，随时都能享受。唯独听云堇唱戏的机会，实在不常有。

所以，云堇的戏迷们常常守在和裕茶馆，谈论云堇演唱过的戏，交流各自赏戏的体会。

茶馆里多了不少常客，十个里九个是云堇的戏迷。

范二爷对此很是满意。

{"list":[{"tab_name":"汉语","table":[{"name":"初次见面…","content":"有道是闻名不如见面，今天终于有缘与你相会，实属荣幸。我姓云，单名一个堇字，不才正是云翰社当家主事的人。我们戏社最近挂靠在和裕茶馆，日后还请多多赏光，常来听戏。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/9bdae121b8d067b95638268ea5154491_7886024134459199914.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·敏感话题","content":"这两天总觉得身上腰封有点紧，难道…我胖了？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/20/16576950/1f01a49a7a13faee14ec2172595c2a3b_687166889709431893.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·闲适","content":"不勒头，不画脸，今天乐得清闲。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/f941ce75ea119b193a509ab7a9c82bd7_2979990754240055336.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·清唱","content":"云婵娟来花婵娟，风流尽在山水间。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/1dfc39fb10ac7c39a98be66fe1c04fa4_1441254673880008879.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打雷的时候…","content":"…嘶，你听、听见打雷没有？吓我一跳。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/71bd7a7bb9a9acb0e95e9b3477f4dbd3_2948679534886631272.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"下雪的时候…","content":"喂呀，冻煞我了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/c04799a2890de846e6d0566bddabfcbe_8967710332147429406.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"阳光很好…","content":"暖阳和煦，真是好风光呀。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e47b368c786fdd68d20f17c2dfbdf8a8_6380982561019984346.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"早上好…","content":"早，清晨露水正好煎茶，喝完这杯茶再出发吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/a78eb4294e24de7f5ef29248dd828d41_3835205005150330797.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"中午好…","content":"午饭吃完之后，想睡一觉…哈…你不困吗？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/1d39626133921ac779ad421c9f21fb4f_6334721147673031875.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"晚上好…","content":"一道去听听晚场说书吧，刘苏先生讲《裁雨声》是一绝。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/1d951cf24664e4b2115ae4afee1f5127_631429099901061749.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"晚安…","content":"夜里寒气重，早点歇息，晚安。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/9150ba2cd85fe20650435a96e8909836_1736179628794112304.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于云堇自己·开蒙","content":"我开蒙早，刚记事的时候父亲就在教我读书了。可惜，他的本事要是有十分，我恐怕只学到了三分。写戏是够用了，但要和饱学之士相比，还差得太远。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/cf89630b6058bdf6415f8b5c2298f7fb_7524716933776032179.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于云堇自己·坐科","content":"我母亲早年是璃月港内大有名气的角儿，我学的戏都是她教的。你是不知道她有多严厉，一想起以前学戏的经历…不不不，我还是别想了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/1251f7e75e8343ac8e48f829ef7275f8_9167212340914780818.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于我们·搭班","content":"最近有几场大戏，正好缺一位擅长舞剑的演员，我觉得你各方面都挺适合。怎么样，有兴趣搭班吗？休息时，还能一起品茶。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/76555f4997a5e6ffebfd13b14f99292f_670607724534243762.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于我们·摇滚","content":"欸，你还听摇滚？正好正好，下回我想出去听演唱会的时候，就找你一块去。回来的时候，我就说是拜访你去了，这下戏社里的老人肯定找不到借口唠叨我。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/40521d83867f7243bccc9ed7ef5c00c7_407874149079921290.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于「神之眼」…","content":"这神之眼嘛…说不定岩王爷也喜欢听戏呢？大概他老人家听得开心，就把神之眼送给我了，哈哈。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/54b7ccc69edf302eafb0d728cace7f2d_3684591648575651918.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"有什么想要分享·饮品","content":"我最喜欢尝试各种各样的饮品。老一辈发明的那些讲究茶饮，什么松间露呀梅上雪的，都让我试了个遍。现在正愁没有新饮品可以喝呢，欸，你有什么推荐吗？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/c4f05e8a2b88846e05ae3bdd4eaba14c_4408659027229031943.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"有什么想要分享·心愿","content":"我偶尔也想脱下戏服，远游海外，去更大的世界看看。为了实现这个心愿，得更加努力才行。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/719cbb36d7988105a1951281b75afe02_3199786862310202416.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"感兴趣的见闻…","content":"每天天刚破晓就能听见莺雀鸣啭，心情总能变得很好。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e0f9e6b439c6d62ec18307f6f589647a_8159145241662976865.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于辛焱…","content":"戏社里那几个老人天天念叨，说是听多了摇滚会被带坏，不让我去听辛焱的演唱会。嘴上说着为我好，哼，我看他们只是接受不了新事物而已。我才不会听他们的，辛焱的演唱会我每周都要去，就是这样。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/cdd1772f900b4e711c7a3e24d1d2e707_4254587489089907841.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于胡桃…","content":"胡桃她呀，表情丰富，脑筋还转得快，哪怕只是聊些家常都能「妙语连珠」。真让人羡慕。和这样的朋友在一起，无论做什么事情都很有趣。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/5e28602672761a15fe754b714fe48e98_4226495939024178492.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于钟离…","content":"我们这行的规矩代代相传，讲究多得很。有些事我只知其然，却不知其所以然。但钟离先生讲起这些竟能如数家珍，有这样懂行的观众，谁不开心呢？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/782e531e41ae5a40073c605b4ceff2e3_511790237159527208.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于凝光…","content":"天权星出手阔绰，没少资助我们戏社。领了她的情，自然也要回报给她最好的演出。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/4a7eb54a8e53ba0bd580ea3504d7e42f_8435534142661005288.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于行秋…","content":"原来你也认识行秋。哈哈，他聪明得很，鬼主意那么多，怕是一不留神就会捉弄你，可得留个心眼啊。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/692314cd9468262f24de4992f18f0f03_2371857818483164906.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于申鹤…","content":"《神女劈观》的剧本我早就念得烂熟，但直到今天我才知道「神女」原来真有其人，世上缘分果然奇妙。惟愿她往后都有好友相伴，不再孤寂。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/021691f4de7a4f6653ecca98371d2de0_1087963462202616686.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于刻晴…","content":"我倒没见过玉衡星来听戏。印象里，路边偶遇这位时，她也总是一副行色匆匆的样子。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/8b803b7f1a1b52e6197e25e6144c52e4_6608116550882130311.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于枫原万叶…","content":"爱听戏的外国人士也有不少，这位枫原万叶就是其中之一。不论台上演的是文场还是武场，他总是安安静静地听，是个规矩的好观众。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/3df831a4357c0bc0089c05e130b08904_7345694293122148583.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解云堇·其一","content":"我们戏社现在常唱的几出戏，有不少是我当家之后新写出来的。写也是我，唱也是我，一人多职，大概是因为这一点，我在璃月港有了些名气。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/db18e120b2089e1fa86254b78348a841_2278820799582721990.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解云堇·其二","content":"按照传统，伶人登台之前要勒头、画脸、穿行头，还有其他一些零碎的准备工作。虽然这样「全副武装」之后扮相会更好看，但也累人。所以我能清唱时就清唱，非得彩唱的话，我往往会挑轻便点的行头。

幸好和我们戏社长期合作的和裕茶馆管得宽松，要不然我真是要累惨了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/96feee92803edba8dcd5953680c94309_6595104648078992686.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解云堇·其三","content":"当初我刚登台唱戏，凭着观众抬爱，不免有些心高气傲。戏本不喜欢就不唱，戏台子小了也不唱，观众少了还是不唱。现在想来，那时候可真是…太傲慢了…以后万万不能这样。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/8725e6118414b214b414e1012ed57eec_1330708359219852953.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解云堇·其四","content":"回想起来，云翰社传到我手上也有段时间了。原本我只懂得写戏、唱戏，从来没把心思放在经营交际上。做了戏社的当家之后，才不得不在这些事上多长点心眼，因此体味到不少人情冷暖…

这时候我才真知道，人生如戏，戏如人生啊。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/7f1932c502d2a47545f14c7af9644e42_1676162415275422497.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解云堇·其五","content":"璃月多传说，大都是些魔神、仙人故事，所以璃月戏里最多的就是神仙戏。最近新演的《神女劈观》就属此类。虽然老戏迷们最爱听的就是这类故事，但如今是「人」的时代，我想多写些属于人类的故事，把天下人心唱给大家听。

这些想法，过去我不曾向人提起。多谢你能耐心听我说这些。有一知音，我很幸运。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/9fcd2f647ef47ca8d28fc0ce35e5f16d_7997732231183815636.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"云堇的爱好…","content":"爱好？当然是戏了。我是打定主意要唱一辈子的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/264236b7f362237d90f67de60e890f67_8122739222445066345.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"云堇的烦恼…","content":"烦恼…唉，为了保持体型，我平时一口都不能多吃。人生在世，连美食都不能奢求，真是遗憾哪。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/9325df0e8d338d6b74ba09d9a6e41bc1_3379542135190009905.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"喜欢的食物…","content":"天枢肉、水煮黑背鲈、干锅腊肉…我都想吃。可惜平时基本吃不了，那个…我就随便问一问，你…会做这几道菜吗？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/59b92ee845a9151f408326dc23b89ef9_2050909921934015063.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"讨厌的食物…","content":"天天都是清炒虾仁，天天都是…再怎么做都还是那个味道，我是真的吃腻了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/563b12088719a9032eb90ad0082f31ea_5467172213695334276.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其一","content":"美食，总会让人倍感幸福…可惜只能点到为止，不能再多吃了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/df8e085ae49a495ba9ca8872f213b1bf_8036614485193148443.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其二","content":"看着就很丰盛！稍等，我去找些饮品来，配着饭菜一起享用吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/5c33b345d08ac37748a1d34ed3a76595_1085741549392587336.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其三","content":"不好意思…这道菜肴呀，我是吃不了多少的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/b672cc4e613e15b6be2ea6292f307de1_3759244985413271797.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生日…","content":"原来今天是你的生日吗？我没有置办宴席的本事，只能为你唱一曲了。不过，这一曲只为你一个人唱，要听什么？你来定。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/da51f73ef0ec2571ab1f8d7bd6346787_4128642386655345000.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·起","content":"俗语说：「业精于勤而荒于嬉。」","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/956164dfbfea990b2adbb1c35365a0ec_4966802044902430074.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·承","content":"勤学苦练至今，总算是有了些成果。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/f85abd147b86d02cfe001bcb830a1007_2387701200849003717.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·转","content":"学枪一事，原先是为了台上舞枪好看，后来是为了掌握傍身武技。如今这两个目标都已达到。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/7ebd9a8b27e69b850ba981f369f63a3b_355369822111024017.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·合","content":"枪术千变万化，奥妙无比，让我庆幸的是，练枪时一直有你相伴。我已经领悟到其中旨要。往后切磋时，你可得小心了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/ff1fb9778de60c1d1df97e46db36600a_4507063075894555822.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其一","content":"着！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/f006ebb8cf7a5e970389ecfcad8cdf5d_6925477831984413064.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其二","content":"崩！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/d2ed52693901c1d33f7a77fbb7a9a3f4_5914545591553477915.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其三","content":"旗来！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/86df5fa7241b79ba27dd47047f7b1a7d_7115577318958168262.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其四","content":"飞云旗！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/1827053afcebfe893424802cc6c53bd7_3766903769677469673.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其五","content":"看枪！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/7079af8f04b2a60e4f7ba32046d61da5_6265424812004354114.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素爆发·其一","content":"听我号令！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/facccafa7fe8b4ba525b881f861a346a_6218396425066532933.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素爆发·其二","content":"勠力同心！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/0cecaccaadbbf0c8d939abe95007505a_1946982635015904588.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素爆发·其三","content":"一鼓作气！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/59cd5c8589bd04975bd52754553bf37d_5326362656816081690.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打开宝箱·其一","content":"我来瞧瞧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/8ef8b41433e9bd5ddfb93dad1e7776b6_3409141075642400989.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打开宝箱·其二","content":"是旅行中用得上的物资吗？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/fb9867de9c648fbb77ca171811fdb16a_1006133505043352680.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打开宝箱·其三","content":"别客气，你收着就行。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/afe5c8b1d1b6e95ddd242ff4a4dd441b_1705616152510772150.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生命值低·其一","content":"别把裙子弄坏了…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/14864d74ad7af94e7f30018d3d5bf467_452807332730147660.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生命值低·其二","content":"得重整旗鼓才行。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/789d874e33c99f217c8dd4dc65c422d0_4083289935395643075.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生命值低·其三","content":"哼，好戏在后面。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/5a81b707e449ea593aa6b54dcc1b9e66_3969755671938513608.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"同伴生命值低·其一","content":"你先下场。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/54a15882a3f9043373b25f6701964987_5933735643022317620.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"同伴生命值低·其二","content":"我来救场。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/1e16f90f5cc93d2d42f34759490ecfc5_2321762647164656532.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"倒下·其一","content":"曲终…人散…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/864990583198c230622fbd469fcdee55_578616602715081974.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"倒下·其二","content":"罢了…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/030f55b6e7ccbb0c16f2a14da1e4d458_1755741173608890275.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"倒下·其三","content":"没办法…唱下去了…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/2e21e0d4b53e615d5cd587c1cd4f56ee_8958369685939073457.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"普通受击·其一","content":"要沉住气…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/1c34187e791b5acec6d1ee70e60c4087_4851670708885540510.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"重受击·其一","content":"有点狼狈…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/9bdb2e081cb63d1111950a7ad42e0a60_1957764562069048936.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"重受击·其二","content":"下手好重…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/9bf644fdc13560f2464c5f6ad5dce3db_5677406352271565960.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"加入队伍·其一","content":"走——了——","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/15bb76b51ac77c8859a4658ca749eddf_7472051251844991344.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"加入队伍·其二","content":"今天该唱哪出呢？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/15d737052ca72759acf3204e2bded883_1954072256179311685.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"加入队伍·其三","content":"你叫我，我当然要来了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/484628e44ff7bf793155f60bd3bc4da4_5544632596364087614.mp3","audio_name":""}],"tab_id":"1698155215629_0"},{"tab_name":"日语","table":[{"name":"初次见面…","content":"有道是闻名不如见面，今天终于有缘与你相会，实属荣幸。我姓云，单名一个堇字，不才正是云翰社当家主事的人。我们戏社最近挂靠在和裕茶馆，日后还请多多赏光，常来听戏。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/684c4baf2caf3f86e7f34ef99e9db51a_4053391036525708514.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·敏感话题","content":"这两天总觉得身上腰封有点紧，难道…我胖了？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/05a74d5f87d1cd172621cdb57c893e17_2533700013297408786.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·闲适","content":"不勒头，不画脸，今天乐得清闲。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/d06d778e5de812dd4366cd49bc996380_8901442218011839380.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·清唱","content":"云婵娟来花婵娟，风流尽在山水间。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/1dfc39fb10ac7c39a98be66fe1c04fa4_8758521196178627229.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打雷的时候…","content":"…嘶，你听、听见打雷没有？吓我一跳。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/d11f8500b609f37bbacb8d79b7cba762_2060983441230445940.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"下雪的时候…","content":"喂呀，冻煞我了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/c04799a2890de846e6d0566bddabfcbe_3183960799197576621.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"阳光很好…","content":"暖阳和煦，真是好风光呀。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/0aaa3bfcbc9f7e75a12f41f59f544674_788887748537566811.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"早上好…","content":"早，清晨露水正好煎茶，喝完这杯茶再出发吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/f291d458cf8d8b733f424269d58ae1b1_1912131492421514372.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"中午好…","content":"午饭吃完之后，想睡一觉…哈…你不困吗？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/f2b3d4d9d3a9c2ce8fefc0a682f8ba5f_2022002234966341342.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"晚上好…","content":"一道去听听晚场说书吧，刘苏先生讲《裁雨声》是一绝。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/9c36f633b6fd94756d306106e54feae2_5437153828890997778.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"晚安…","content":"夜里寒气重，早点歇息，晚安。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e96a2a30f6cd35efa78cce7aa9cfea40_3274633240355063978.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于云堇自己·开蒙","content":"我开蒙早，刚记事的时候父亲就在教我读书了。可惜，他的本事要是有十分，我恐怕只学到了三分。写戏是够用了，但要和饱学之士相比，还差得太远。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/ac08744f1e4b20d57f877a884dac4bb8_2998508616263219622.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于云堇自己·坐科","content":"我母亲早年是璃月港内大有名气的角儿，我学的戏都是她教的。你是不知道她有多严厉，一想起以前学戏的经历…不不不，我还是别想了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/3794fd4cd74d2433543ff3d90f041a8b_2445526887116612279.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于我们·搭班","content":"最近有几场大戏，正好缺一位擅长舞剑的演员，我觉得你各方面都挺适合。怎么样，有兴趣搭班吗？休息时，还能一起品茶。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/076391a9a1fd8bf2d9639d572bb45dcf_622532638834438711.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于我们·摇滚","content":"欸，你还听摇滚？正好正好，下回我想出去听演唱会的时候，就找你一块去。回来的时候，我就说是拜访你去了，这下戏社里的老人肯定找不到借口唠叨我。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/0cf32c3b51159896a94b450d17f9e004_5768034372033833288.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于「神之眼」…","content":"这神之眼嘛…说不定岩王爷也喜欢听戏呢？大概他老人家听得开心，就把神之眼送给我了，哈哈。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/9cf86013bae2291ae05ddd72daa199d3_5591269477340984991.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"有什么想要分享·饮品","content":"我最喜欢尝试各种各样的饮品。老一辈发明的那些讲究茶饮，什么松间露呀梅上雪的，都让我试了个遍。现在正愁没有新饮品可以喝呢，欸，你有什么推荐吗？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/7e185f49a86540246a812f52334ae749_4200759615142759762.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"有什么想要分享·心愿","content":"我偶尔也想脱下戏服，远游海外，去更大的世界看看。为了实现这个心愿，得更加努力才行。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/d12e77cc35f5f7be0daec809d0285886_1601194810846846751.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"感兴趣的见闻…","content":"每天天刚破晓就能听见莺雀鸣啭，心情总能变得很好。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/855e90794bde110c2af8dfc7ffc53a01_481048833924210832.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于辛焱…","content":"戏社里那几个老人天天念叨，说是听多了摇滚会被带坏，不让我去听辛焱的演唱会。嘴上说着为我好，哼，我看他们只是接受不了新事物而已。我才不会听他们的，辛焱的演唱会我每周都要去，就是这样。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/3c15fb62ec66d46ceacdb1eb9e165ffc_8835826170650581522.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于胡桃…","content":"胡桃她呀，表情丰富，脑筋还转得快，哪怕只是聊些家常都能「妙语连珠」。真让人羡慕。和这样的朋友在一起，无论做什么事情都很有趣。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/73f6e7da3e6d067b974b8674e8c10934_164636089572628670.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于钟离…","content":"我们这行的规矩代代相传，讲究多得很。有些事我只知其然，却不知其所以然。但钟离先生讲起这些竟能如数家珍，有这样懂行的观众，谁不开心呢？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e37e1060417e710597e7495909f5179a_5417624029213683320.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于凝光…","content":"天权星出手阔绰，没少资助我们戏社。领了她的情，自然也要回报给她最好的演出。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/c3966971b4dc1e6eb275f7e2fca3f132_9064011916889874703.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于行秋…","content":"原来你也认识行秋。哈哈，他聪明得很，鬼主意那么多，怕是一不留神就会捉弄你，可得留个心眼啊。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/ba9448b7aefca906d832f15a616afefe_889774438968868770.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于申鹤…","content":"《神女劈观》的剧本我早就念得烂熟，但直到今天我才知道「神女」原来真有其人，世上缘分果然奇妙。惟愿她往后都有好友相伴，不再孤寂。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/0268bf842bca928a49de33bd21a220c2_8416185932137104354.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于刻晴…","content":"我倒没见过玉衡星来听戏。印象里，路边偶遇这位时，她也总是一副行色匆匆的样子。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/cb1bd66c65d51c1b498df733297510d5_6116878963590882879.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于枫原万叶…","content":"爱听戏的外国人士也有不少，这位枫原万叶就是其中之一。不论台上演的是文场还是武场，他总是安安静静地听，是个规矩的好观众。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/9e0c39ed312a8b8d659107c4d19d491e_6351637224557342228.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解云堇·其一","content":"我们戏社现在常唱的几出戏，有不少是我当家之后新写出来的。写也是我，唱也是我，一人多职，大概是因为这一点，我在璃月港有了些名气。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/91547938c5cb9456e04f0162e89221a7_3931842231802592896.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解云堇·其二","content":"按照传统，伶人登台之前要勒头、画脸、穿行头，还有其他一些零碎的准备工作。虽然这样「全副武装」之后扮相会更好看，但也累人。所以我能清唱时就清唱，非得彩唱的话，我往往会挑轻便点的行头。

幸好和我们戏社长期合作的和裕茶馆管得宽松，要不然我真是要累惨了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/3ee9f06bb647fd7659b8097dd0ad3140_8196080195894928185.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解云堇·其三","content":"当初我刚登台唱戏，凭着观众抬爱，不免有些心高气傲。戏本不喜欢就不唱，戏台子小了也不唱，观众少了还是不唱。现在想来，那时候可真是…太傲慢了…以后万万不能这样。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e7b7c4ece31ca3180d8fe6a4c816d61b_7780627464592718412.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解云堇·其四","content":"回想起来，云翰社传到我手上也有段时间了。原本我只懂得写戏、唱戏，从来没把心思放在经营交际上。做了戏社的当家之后，才不得不在这些事上多长点心眼，因此体味到不少人情冷暖…

这时候我才真知道，人生如戏，戏如人生啊。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/2df17c569e320f8f268481bacf30e735_5032566241197911913.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解云堇·其五","content":"璃月多传说，大都是些魔神、仙人故事，所以璃月戏里最多的就是神仙戏。最近新演的《神女劈观》就属此类。虽然老戏迷们最爱听的就是这类故事，但如今是「人」的时代，我想多写些属于人类的故事，把天下人心唱给大家听。

这些想法，过去我不曾向人提起。多谢你能耐心听我说这些。有一知音，我很幸运。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/4777561631429f9c3c981bb3fe2147f6_2733974748193395218.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"云堇的爱好…","content":"爱好？当然是戏了。我是打定主意要唱一辈子的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/00f8eac6e0d11a30e4d7bc462e1ca94f_1576600526876642591.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"云堇的烦恼…","content":"烦恼…唉，为了保持体型，我平时一口都不能多吃。人生在世，连美食都不能奢求，真是遗憾哪。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/5ffb56de5970f5b2b3017a5683b10cd4_5461872372128241479.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"喜欢的食物…","content":"天枢肉、水煮黑背鲈、干锅腊肉…我都想吃。可惜平时基本吃不了，那个…我就随便问一问，你…会做这几道菜吗？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/a895e675b69438c2901aeca9f266f9d1_3914024034552363424.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"讨厌的食物…","content":"天天都是清炒虾仁，天天都是…再怎么做都还是那个味道，我是真的吃腻了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/bd66b28f454a9f078d25d02af641018a_9101399880108175863.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其一","content":"美食，总会让人倍感幸福…可惜只能点到为止，不能再多吃了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/30597908092b47bb7c593d5017992508_2338260513947071562.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其二","content":"看着就很丰盛！稍等，我去找些饮品来，配着饭菜一起享用吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/a34aaab4d814a9030f6103c3b918331b_6089852959360926853.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其三","content":"不好意思…这道菜肴呀，我是吃不了多少的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/ad34e4e2cd807bdd81a05e55af52f14c_4789282906386750408.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生日…","content":"原来今天是你的生日吗？我没有置办宴席的本事，只能为你唱一曲了。不过，这一曲只为你一个人唱，要听什么？你来定。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/1ef80ed9db865de3a1a9d8573e45c335_6314413117628379624.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·起","content":"俗语说：「业精于勤而荒于嬉。」","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/a0c4d7bdb5c7e1e0d097ebfc0d5f9f29_8875179733992899178.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·承","content":"勤学苦练至今，总算是有了些成果。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/91a5dc5c8b39b1e7e7b93fead851a9ba_1983418081990631390.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·转","content":"学枪一事，原先是为了台上舞枪好看，后来是为了掌握傍身武技。如今这两个目标都已达到。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/9ec64fc281cc89d134dbca0e678d5a55_4768292668668040713.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·合","content":"枪术千变万化，奥妙无比，让我庆幸的是，练枪时一直有你相伴。我已经领悟到其中旨要。往后切磋时，你可得小心了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/78deb9ff5f535471fb8b3204ff692efb_5196781591749186792.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其一","content":"着！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/741ae78efac7899957a5b0128df09f3b_538398562194761455.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其二","content":"崩！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/8d1c7e4288e2cfa95a364db19c2c2bcd_7705490599693859113.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其三","content":"旗来！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/327ba818883896295ee3f0deaf8e8aa9_1876425630976885389.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其四","content":"飞云旗！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/33a41e026124402e2b910d3dcbc64732_8744571662731741450.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其五","content":"看枪！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/08/19/183046623/e09ff11f1c7349adc49209b73e001f01_8603075067578491657.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素爆发·其一","content":"听我号令！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/83cb7b0e63346c0ace00464a3ac1496a_4782664947021398073.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素爆发·其二","content":"勠力同心！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/26d6d083d2e99da54e7206a6e8719ef4_1486840401604703835.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素爆发·其三","content":"一鼓作气！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/3ff6790be8993cc07a330b4c10e10143_3328476507725134163.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打开宝箱·其一","content":"我来瞧瞧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/107e7f58d4814eaefcfff4e3f42340cc_4975775887656368739.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打开宝箱·其二","content":"是旅行中用得上的物资吗？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/12bc469ae9695819cdfaae9050c8bc66_4395664798330000125.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打开宝箱·其三","content":"别客气，你收着就行。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e62cb7f6995cdf2d645362e0d0bc28a4_7125717738885649610.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生命值低·其一","content":"别把裙子弄坏了…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/48ee42a6d0aa7c90ea41784c769723c5_544254672449729309.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生命值低·其二","content":"得重整旗鼓才行。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/921609e238c79521bb5cf6edc5c89b17_720080825984325743.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生命值低·其三","content":"哼，好戏在后面。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/1b1d4b777e5c66f910dc54d1d9cee81e_2711380964978764802.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"同伴生命值低·其一","content":"你先下场。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/7f4d7c493ce30afcdda90498b72c69a4_4168094598620730808.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"同伴生命值低·其二","content":"我来救场。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/77069cc943a94ba8c68e613ab7b21611_2065312973340138892.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"倒下·其一","content":"曲终…人散…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/a3a0610c06ae1c42b656484c47a0c407_8310956532208688129.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"倒下·其二","content":"罢了…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/8adfb8e4b423e36e60246e028d16d73c_1103631114417904862.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"倒下·其三","content":"没办法…唱下去了…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/d85b740b712ffb0c5f119277ac30376c_3874487300068400340.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"普通受击·其一","content":"要沉住气…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/153dab052719268f042177d28a4ccf54_3100213150790945509.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"重受击·其一","content":"有点狼狈…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/8a9bf198a043d47bbfcd775ed53996bd_3747778084974388536.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"重受击·其二","content":"下手好重…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/81e077d021f13a84aa4db0601de6962e_2578036129133076813.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"加入队伍·其一","content":"走——了——","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/15bb76b51ac77c8859a4658ca749eddf_6216436273021446867.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"加入队伍·其二","content":"今天该唱哪出呢？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/2f0a3436c3be6c5a8d80d1faec21ce4c_106261496913898258.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"加入队伍·其三","content":"你叫我，我当然要来了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/6a3e2c17d94fd7373d8d1b3ccee819af_7699715705832449482.mp3","audio_name":""}],"tab_id":"1698155215629_1"},{"tab_name":"韩语","table":[{"name":"初次见面…","content":"有道是闻名不如见面，今天终于有缘与你相会，实属荣幸。我姓云，单名一个堇字，不才正是云翰社当家主事的人。我们戏社最近挂靠在和裕茶馆，日后还请多多赏光，常来听戏。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/ff6c13f7330afb4780891d6fb449a96d_1658880375722309867.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·敏感话题","content":"这两天总觉得身上腰封有点紧，难道…我胖了？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/7d8f6e8c0fc96230d52422b04d683115_4203718002365833262.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·闲适","content":"不勒头，不画脸，今天乐得清闲。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/12672769951c7f24b1285e5696a22cd0_3682583395800192757.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·清唱","content":"云婵娟来花婵娟，风流尽在山水间。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/1dfc39fb10ac7c39a98be66fe1c04fa4_5538057748526565442.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打雷的时候…","content":"…嘶，你听、听见打雷没有？吓我一跳。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/7a0cf5f08a300f16d42f9f82efca2ad2_7138973678507040285.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"下雪的时候…","content":"喂呀，冻煞我了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/c04799a2890de846e6d0566bddabfcbe_8165413344739943785.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"阳光很好…","content":"暖阳和煦，真是好风光呀。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/15f047ae3555643e24792da784038c3f_589226271006581638.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"早上好…","content":"早，清晨露水正好煎茶，喝完这杯茶再出发吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/6d8109c7475578833b17d98848a6dc8d_7398727967145312634.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"中午好…","content":"午饭吃完之后，想睡一觉…哈…你不困吗？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/aaf2dccca4cc36c6a2a15f08485f2ed6_7422344905142276510.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"晚上好…","content":"一道去听听晚场说书吧，刘苏先生讲《裁雨声》是一绝。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/4b5c8a056bce66175a08f0b607089ce1_4194779265888383984.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"晚安…","content":"夜里寒气重，早点歇息，晚安。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/31f7c023e99d96844a142f11dbc56006_6654770736770144378.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于云堇自己·开蒙","content":"我开蒙早，刚记事的时候父亲就在教我读书了。可惜，他的本事要是有十分，我恐怕只学到了三分。写戏是够用了，但要和饱学之士相比，还差得太远。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/c0b8aa52bdce5e46d16a479e5b03dd13_1010790320914774080.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于云堇自己·坐科","content":"我母亲早年是璃月港内大有名气的角儿，我学的戏都是她教的。你是不知道她有多严厉，一想起以前学戏的经历…不不不，我还是别想了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/d1d71918d31bd6104442fd54e3013e31_3883002949079477170.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于我们·搭班","content":"最近有几场大戏，正好缺一位擅长舞剑的演员，我觉得你各方面都挺适合。怎么样，有兴趣搭班吗？休息时，还能一起品茶。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/3b7e564cc31a3813f6722c90d80ea94d_8804576478182028828.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于我们·摇滚","content":"欸，你还听摇滚？正好正好，下回我想出去听演唱会的时候，就找你一块去。回来的时候，我就说是拜访你去了，这下戏社里的老人肯定找不到借口唠叨我。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/49181624e7074b037f21090624de78b2_3059684122730150824.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于「神之眼」…","content":"这神之眼嘛…说不定岩王爷也喜欢听戏呢？大概他老人家听得开心，就把神之眼送给我了，哈哈。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/5de9060570bf4d95ecf4dcfcbe3f257e_7582596159273182072.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"有什么想要分享·饮品","content":"我最喜欢尝试各种各样的饮品。老一辈发明的那些讲究茶饮，什么松间露呀梅上雪的，都让我试了个遍。现在正愁没有新饮品可以喝呢，欸，你有什么推荐吗？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/7c8b61dbc2a5724aa6a23ff98524a2ea_8381919995516798448.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"有什么想要分享·心愿","content":"我偶尔也想脱下戏服，远游海外，去更大的世界看看。为了实现这个心愿，得更加努力才行。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/75413e7cec6ad40f5e32d0d149b06764_9068983816384504514.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"感兴趣的见闻…","content":"每天天刚破晓就能听见莺雀鸣啭，心情总能变得很好。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/2ddbba75bffc29ca92cf1f0bcc82dde4_2959887858287604558.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于辛焱…","content":"戏社里那几个老人天天念叨，说是听多了摇滚会被带坏，不让我去听辛焱的演唱会。嘴上说着为我好，哼，我看他们只是接受不了新事物而已。我才不会听他们的，辛焱的演唱会我每周都要去，就是这样。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/3275703f31396438fe4432a7f1fa749a_8003084174235696131.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于胡桃…","content":"胡桃她呀，表情丰富，脑筋还转得快，哪怕只是聊些家常都能「妙语连珠」。真让人羡慕。和这样的朋友在一起，无论做什么事情都很有趣。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/57c360c870413637cf11852861f834bc_4626222877496661848.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于钟离…","content":"我们这行的规矩代代相传，讲究多得很。有些事我只知其然，却不知其所以然。但钟离先生讲起这些竟能如数家珍，有这样懂行的观众，谁不开心呢？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/d57ab25e5ac7a834af1d4ea41645a781_2953964335746871500.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于凝光…","content":"天权星出手阔绰，没少资助我们戏社。领了她的情，自然也要回报给她最好的演出。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/7657e29ce49a427541337f68e0d5e551_2014286155127799015.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于行秋…","content":"原来你也认识行秋。哈哈，他聪明得很，鬼主意那么多，怕是一不留神就会捉弄你，可得留个心眼啊。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/996c167451f90e019c339452b042de87_6770405839788599968.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于申鹤…","content":"《神女劈观》的剧本我早就念得烂熟，但直到今天我才知道「神女」原来真有其人，世上缘分果然奇妙。惟愿她往后都有好友相伴，不再孤寂。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/5312fa2c4bb9bfa0f0d6a249a3758318_7889035257365094443.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于刻晴…","content":"我倒没见过玉衡星来听戏。印象里，路边偶遇这位时，她也总是一副行色匆匆的样子。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/7ce00a5156a411d1230f3b04d6edd23a_8033215232086767245.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于枫原万叶…","content":"爱听戏的外国人士也有不少，这位枫原万叶就是其中之一。不论台上演的是文场还是武场，他总是安安静静地听，是个规矩的好观众。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/9ef15fd48ab1b902d482118d33473b5c_765442742965704358.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解云堇·其一","content":"我们戏社现在常唱的几出戏，有不少是我当家之后新写出来的。写也是我，唱也是我，一人多职，大概是因为这一点，我在璃月港有了些名气。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/5bb2a10bbd3e8cd5e8f5d802f548974c_2598780462873212856.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解云堇·其二","content":"按照传统，伶人登台之前要勒头、画脸、穿行头，还有其他一些零碎的准备工作。虽然这样「全副武装」之后扮相会更好看，但也累人。所以我能清唱时就清唱，非得彩唱的话，我往往会挑轻便点的行头。

幸好和我们戏社长期合作的和裕茶馆管得宽松，要不然我真是要累惨了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/7361c7bd676d82835dad4cd26bbd86f5_2434662678332957784.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解云堇·其三","content":"当初我刚登台唱戏，凭着观众抬爱，不免有些心高气傲。戏本不喜欢就不唱，戏台子小了也不唱，观众少了还是不唱。现在想来，那时候可真是…太傲慢了…以后万万不能这样。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/2bfbf827a738ee338260c6cfdd3e336f_6615489000901204078.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解云堇·其四","content":"回想起来，云翰社传到我手上也有段时间了。原本我只懂得写戏、唱戏，从来没把心思放在经营交际上。做了戏社的当家之后，才不得不在这些事上多长点心眼，因此体味到不少人情冷暖…

这时候我才真知道，人生如戏，戏如人生啊。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/02a0e85c8929a7cb0d161034649b98d0_8611380587999688913.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解云堇·其五","content":"璃月多传说，大都是些魔神、仙人故事，所以璃月戏里最多的就是神仙戏。最近新演的《神女劈观》就属此类。虽然老戏迷们最爱听的就是这类故事，但如今是「人」的时代，我想多写些属于人类的故事，把天下人心唱给大家听。

这些想法，过去我不曾向人提起。多谢你能耐心听我说这些。有一知音，我很幸运。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/b1b19e912885eaab0e90f2208313cb02_7879967378727494072.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"云堇的爱好…","content":"爱好？当然是戏了。我是打定主意要唱一辈子的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/dd8a33434ed3f1dc891724518a4ababf_5273274773164389009.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"云堇的烦恼…","content":"烦恼…唉，为了保持体型，我平时一口都不能多吃。人生在世，连美食都不能奢求，真是遗憾哪。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/c9e75da1f5f0b2431ea6f69b91742935_6688009230401534831.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"喜欢的食物…","content":"天枢肉、水煮黑背鲈、干锅腊肉…我都想吃。可惜平时基本吃不了，那个…我就随便问一问，你…会做这几道菜吗？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/68a55310373bc9440836bc6feb80158c_1741787545206270188.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"讨厌的食物…","content":"天天都是清炒虾仁，天天都是…再怎么做都还是那个味道，我是真的吃腻了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/582af2f3dd59c8cf4eea881f52d328ad_2882181844417976169.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其一","content":"美食，总会让人倍感幸福…可惜只能点到为止，不能再多吃了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/a84c97bbe696747d26e4ce72ef7e884f_1525113845528931999.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其二","content":"看着就很丰盛！稍等，我去找些饮品来，配着饭菜一起享用吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/a5689210e6edb63db1b2cf0b969b7c4b_2621988247295232278.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其三","content":"不好意思…这道菜肴呀，我是吃不了多少的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/c4c74b6cc58bfed1e39926ed0842ad7f_1295553441055260057.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生日…","content":"原来今天是你的生日吗？我没有置办宴席的本事，只能为你唱一曲了。不过，这一曲只为你一个人唱，要听什么？你来定。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/f2afe16d60811a93283c6fd11c7b8aa3_2542103891242696396.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·起","content":"俗语说：「业精于勤而荒于嬉。」","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/2dda453ddfb1992d627998d8239edad8_3436871417221930649.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·承","content":"勤学苦练至今，总算是有了些成果。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/3413e2ca245756ab91923fa99da2d7c0_3114043106503543850.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·转","content":"学枪一事，原先是为了台上舞枪好看，后来是为了掌握傍身武技。如今这两个目标都已达到。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/5852514bda5426aaf8ae657e5eeb93a8_4602508778744043655.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·合","content":"枪术千变万化，奥妙无比，让我庆幸的是，练枪时一直有你相伴。我已经领悟到其中旨要。往后切磋时，你可得小心了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/57c0d2f2de217e0bdd717ade6bd6a217_5616478648457220645.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其一","content":"着！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/2526aa441de377a2fe742c9bfe98a24e_5429861435114013150.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其二","content":"崩！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/f20e9242eb10b5d7fb37694e0cd1ee57_4818499947038228914.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其三","content":"旗来！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/6ecc3e826a6ebef8cd6b0bc4cb63522f_4943138709783270216.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其四","content":"飞云旗！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/c7d7bedadd3ecee1a9a72d9717292227_6878052565068872029.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其五","content":"看枪！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/eebd3399e44cd048458078bbc9130958_7358588117342830802.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素爆发·其一","content":"听我号令！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/5624498f10364fd253448269e977009b_6448080206715895226.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素爆发·其二","content":"勠力同心！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/31bd01a7fd303e0c037cbffb5fcf8956_8939614429005418592.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素爆发·其三","content":"一鼓作气！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/4a0914d6262165a8ee339cc7adf7b7ff_2375162326131700743.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打开宝箱·其一","content":"我来瞧瞧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/dc8a44f37cc6f0adcf6db7490d5356e0_958481152239863522.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打开宝箱·其二","content":"是旅行中用得上的物资吗？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/89a218058b56aca644a68f22cbb54796_7872639721320215258.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打开宝箱·其三","content":"别客气，你收着就行。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/f2bc39552cba46c714ac1726a9860d2e_8926964164674958521.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生命值低·其一","content":"别把裙子弄坏了…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/5f00ab503620b4ff50bc0adbbbb67fcd_4433841643389068383.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生命值低·其二","content":"得重整旗鼓才行。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/bdfdcb179b03a41721976a18972ba05b_5445322877268070428.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生命值低·其三","content":"哼，好戏在后面。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/fc4102f7c880ca37dd2df013f57f0d8d_7465290393654373498.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"同伴生命值低·其一","content":"你先下场。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/9ddc75f71c44fb8703eebe68268715f9_9212546590181607334.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"同伴生命值低·其二","content":"我来救场。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/8a9992a0ba3eb625d3cd55bc5dc0fe52_4677740775563686911.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"倒下·其一","content":"曲终…人散…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/b170864b7da9c71c8327830ad0a20503_4057649050251026649.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"倒下·其二","content":"罢了…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/163c8d5ae213e82dbc539f05dead3975_1572268342491233868.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"倒下·其三","content":"没办法…唱下去了…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/66d3df730268efd795a373e77058b2fc_4778851729726529958.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"普通受击·其一","content":"要沉住气…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/ba6547f533f68fe8e92fa0a3e13704cb_5401584675777857081.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"重受击·其一","content":"有点狼狈…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/26e3fe300b215a665785028c38f9559c_5785228747485746328.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"重受击·其二","content":"下手好重…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e96a0dfcc39485cf750621a27dbef8f1_7134427486240303662.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"加入队伍·其一","content":"走——了——","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/15bb76b51ac77c8859a4658ca749eddf_3608855583825420963.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"加入队伍·其二","content":"今天该唱哪出呢？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/28207fa24e1f9696c84953ae7741adf9_1914321207054160077.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"加入队伍·其三","content":"你叫我，我当然要来了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/b1e1eefe3ee9da471921d3047939e1ea_526836198362540431.mp3","audio_name":""}],"tab_id":"1698155215629_2"},{"tab_name":"英语","table":[{"name":"初次见面…","content":"有道是闻名不如见面，今天终于有缘与你相会，实属荣幸。我姓云，单名一个堇字，不才正是云翰社当家主事的人。我们戏社最近挂靠在和裕茶馆，日后还请多多赏光，常来听戏。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/f7987ce4c387b2f30487e65d0ac53b19_3323222618873946696.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·敏感话题","content":"这两天总觉得身上腰封有点紧，难道…我胖了？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/531cc1368e05155d2df429624da76603_3908228576061421550.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·闲适","content":"不勒头，不画脸，今天乐得清闲。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/8581560f260be9262de43fac2160cef7_2321624518838364582.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·清唱","content":"云婵娟来花婵娟，风流尽在山水间。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/1dfc39fb10ac7c39a98be66fe1c04fa4_4393159325165992255.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打雷的时候…","content":"…嘶，你听、听见打雷没有？吓我一跳。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/5ee9020f02b50250d37583da18ecece0_5696926964564999296.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"下雪的时候…","content":"喂呀，冻煞我了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/c04799a2890de846e6d0566bddabfcbe_3841383713221113815.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"阳光很好…","content":"暖阳和煦，真是好风光呀。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/44338d2c46abbeeddcbcd8895604240c_4775397073555648807.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"早上好…","content":"早，清晨露水正好煎茶，喝完这杯茶再出发吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/2469abc059caccd931bfb85839f1785b_3670740159781828908.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"中午好…","content":"午饭吃完之后，想睡一觉…哈…你不困吗？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/1b50440ab07bfb513a5c579fd0449db4_5455430586366224293.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"晚上好…","content":"一道去听听晚场说书吧，刘苏先生讲《裁雨声》是一绝。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/1f9f680507c3ef6c8e2806990d5a1fe0_5932760784892696459.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"晚安…","content":"夜里寒气重，早点歇息，晚安。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/7c52920c43263a629e8b9c2e874c381e_6326279625298029253.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于云堇自己·开蒙","content":"我开蒙早，刚记事的时候父亲就在教我读书了。可惜，他的本事要是有十分，我恐怕只学到了三分。写戏是够用了，但要和饱学之士相比，还差得太远。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/eb78c7d620ba30d8fc964881c0992372_1969552041812923487.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于云堇自己·坐科","content":"我母亲早年是璃月港内大有名气的角儿，我学的戏都是她教的。你是不知道她有多严厉，一想起以前学戏的经历…不不不，我还是别想了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/6c3e6597a18d91ca5fcee84093f3725f_5309045414545038464.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于我们·搭班","content":"最近有几场大戏，正好缺一位擅长舞剑的演员，我觉得你各方面都挺适合。怎么样，有兴趣搭班吗？休息时，还能一起品茶。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/2e3fbe0d58bda18d415f152a9849fc54_6564563925530336283.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于我们·摇滚","content":"欸，你还听摇滚？正好正好，下回我想出去听演唱会的时候，就找你一块去。回来的时候，我就说是拜访你去了，这下戏社里的老人肯定找不到借口唠叨我。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/bd5338790ad1dfea89ec99a99b130c40_1795071245985836676.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于「神之眼」…","content":"这神之眼嘛…说不定岩王爷也喜欢听戏呢？大概他老人家听得开心，就把神之眼送给我了，哈哈。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/6512792c8697d6516e42f1702a0139d9_6099396210481327912.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"有什么想要分享·饮品","content":"我最喜欢尝试各种各样的饮品。老一辈发明的那些讲究茶饮，什么松间露呀梅上雪的，都让我试了个遍。现在正愁没有新饮品可以喝呢，欸，你有什么推荐吗？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/b6a9cd4bc124df9d2c35d0da5199976f_8949056040416682443.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"有什么想要分享·心愿","content":"我偶尔也想脱下戏服，远游海外，去更大的世界看看。为了实现这个心愿，得更加努力才行。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/47fff6c0570ae979b769dbd9e3cf2270_6158450414704554224.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"感兴趣的见闻…","content":"每天天刚破晓就能听见莺雀鸣啭，心情总能变得很好。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/3f237c2b254fb41cef81d0bb9b1210ef_2050375670152402742.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于辛焱…","content":"戏社里那几个老人天天念叨，说是听多了摇滚会被带坏，不让我去听辛焱的演唱会。嘴上说着为我好，哼，我看他们只是接受不了新事物而已。我才不会听他们的，辛焱的演唱会我每周都要去，就是这样。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/85018b8762417c53cc70cfb58989d8a3_5417203330839917900.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于胡桃…","content":"胡桃她呀，表情丰富，脑筋还转得快，哪怕只是聊些家常都能「妙语连珠」。真让人羡慕。和这样的朋友在一起，无论做什么事情都很有趣。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/1e643c8e6a23753b7d06a78d97566bce_1433435540389451251.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于钟离…","content":"我们这行的规矩代代相传，讲究多得很。有些事我只知其然，却不知其所以然。但钟离先生讲起这些竟能如数家珍，有这样懂行的观众，谁不开心呢？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/cd1874c22e8cbfd035e26920c8d5c8d4_3815510864880414625.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于凝光…","content":"天权星出手阔绰，没少资助我们戏社。领了她的情，自然也要回报给她最好的演出。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/39adb64932fd9b6a1efbc08c478510ed_495418047808416358.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于行秋…","content":"原来你也认识行秋。哈哈，他聪明得很，鬼主意那么多，怕是一不留神就会捉弄你，可得留个心眼啊。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/0a00582d660ee6bae9ebeff8db84163c_8267282689547060649.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于申鹤…","content":"《神女劈观》的剧本我早就念得烂熟，但直到今天我才知道「神女」原来真有其人，世上缘分果然奇妙。惟愿她往后都有好友相伴，不再孤寂。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/a31804ee1bfdc34bde7821c07f60e935_7444102118624795588.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于刻晴…","content":"我倒没见过玉衡星来听戏。印象里，路边偶遇这位时，她也总是一副行色匆匆的样子。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/854cae1f33485531c77323fb461aff81_7747172104085461934.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于枫原万叶…","content":"爱听戏的外国人士也有不少，这位枫原万叶就是其中之一。不论台上演的是文场还是武场，他总是安安静静地听，是个规矩的好观众。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/b090cc5a2b1976feffd493a143e26149_5618747865562601893.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解云堇·其一","content":"我们戏社现在常唱的几出戏，有不少是我当家之后新写出来的。写也是我，唱也是我，一人多职，大概是因为这一点，我在璃月港有了些名气。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/45eba78d9e8caabc96b36c2e7a5ef9d5_1147647760262921776.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解云堇·其二","content":"按照传统，伶人登台之前要勒头、画脸、穿行头，还有其他一些零碎的准备工作。虽然这样「全副武装」之后扮相会更好看，但也累人。所以我能清唱时就清唱，非得彩唱的话，我往往会挑轻便点的行头。

幸好和我们戏社长期合作的和裕茶馆管得宽松，要不然我真是要累惨了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/1a79eb0172b6740b47c77932636f1e05_1226646744411818283.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解云堇·其三","content":"当初我刚登台唱戏，凭着观众抬爱，不免有些心高气傲。戏本不喜欢就不唱，戏台子小了也不唱，观众少了还是不唱。现在想来，那时候可真是…太傲慢了…以后万万不能这样。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/a4a11635cd32a5a6f9460e31ddab3542_3793788837774724762.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解云堇·其四","content":"回想起来，云翰社传到我手上也有段时间了。原本我只懂得写戏、唱戏，从来没把心思放在经营交际上。做了戏社的当家之后，才不得不在这些事上多长点心眼，因此体味到不少人情冷暖…

这时候我才真知道，人生如戏，戏如人生啊。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/f78225632fdfd93007fab7bfb49152e8_3992204829004471901.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解云堇·其五","content":"璃月多传说，大都是些魔神、仙人故事，所以璃月戏里最多的就是神仙戏。最近新演的《神女劈观》就属此类。虽然老戏迷们最爱听的就是这类故事，但如今是「人」的时代，我想多写些属于人类的故事，把天下人心唱给大家听。

这些想法，过去我不曾向人提起。多谢你能耐心听我说这些。有一知音，我很幸运。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/54ef036503b9eba9151eac177c173667_798359086374980420.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"云堇的爱好…","content":"爱好？当然是戏了。我是打定主意要唱一辈子的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/c0d075423bbc4a46f5825be760d8903e_3592434970413193699.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"云堇的烦恼…","content":"烦恼…唉，为了保持体型，我平时一口都不能多吃。人生在世，连美食都不能奢求，真是遗憾哪。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/a403dfac10c55595bc3fded123ac1409_651973936470741693.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"喜欢的食物…","content":"天枢肉、水煮黑背鲈、干锅腊肉…我都想吃。可惜平时基本吃不了，那个…我就随便问一问，你…会做这几道菜吗？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/c57f2ba8d6fbfda3d96914e334c3bd88_3201056491610112521.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"讨厌的食物…","content":"天天都是清炒虾仁，天天都是…再怎么做都还是那个味道，我是真的吃腻了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/4f2d1180dbc476ec514c510608927844_3764694196117744250.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其一","content":"美食，总会让人倍感幸福…可惜只能点到为止，不能再多吃了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/2d29eea4acbff81e0804ba12d27b2466_7145926650805372183.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其二","content":"看着就很丰盛！稍等，我去找些饮品来，配着饭菜一起享用吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/6ecaf5bea10a798c4ee52c8ee4e8cfe2_1893738908917853448.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其三","content":"不好意思…这道菜肴呀，我是吃不了多少的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/bbdad65d1ff8d87256c199a430012fee_8910799504510932844.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生日…","content":"原来今天是你的生日吗？我没有置办宴席的本事，只能为你唱一曲了。不过，这一曲只为你一个人唱，要听什么？你来定。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/bc984fe82a0d689c3c556f47e607e7f9_1628073282530405147.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·起","content":"俗语说：「业精于勤而荒于嬉。」","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/b0bed4036 璃月人从祖辈处继承的传统艺术有许多种，璃月戏正是其中之一。

璃月戏历史悠久。传承至今，这—辈曲艺人演唱的璃月戏，已经和它最初的模样大不相同。

幸运的是，今天的璃月戏依然保有古璃月戏那般纷繁复杂的声乐，和百转千回的曲调。

今天的璃月曲艺人往往结社演出。众多戏社中，最知名的当属「云翰社」。

「云翰社」由曲艺世家云家代代传承，如今的当家是璃月港内风头正劲的名角——云堇。

云堇年少成名，初次登台就以清脆甜美的唱腔及活泼俏丽的扮相征服了观众。

随着担纲的剧目逐渐增多，她那灵动多变、真实自然的演绎风格也越发成熟。

无论是娇柔端庄的闺中千金，还是义薄云天的巾帼女杰，她都能拿捏得恰到好处。

更为难得的是，这位年轻的演员还懂得写戏。除《神女劈观》外，「云翰社」近年来还有不少新剧，皆出自云堇之手。

也难怪老戏迷们戏瘾上来，第一时间总会想到去和裕茶馆打听云堇何时开演。

云堇出身于璃月曲艺世家。

她母亲继承了祖父的衣钵，曾是蜚声璃月港内的名角。她的父亲则是一名剧作家。

诞生在如此家庭中的云堇，自幼耳濡目染，总爱跟着母亲一起咿呀哼唱璃月戏。

通常来说，人童年的喜好总是难成其一生志业。云堇却不在此列。

小云堇对璃月戏的痴迷绝非儿戏，她还主动要求父母指导自己。

女儿的坚持让父母欢喜，自然不吝指导。因此，云堇小小年纪就开始学戏。

璃月戏讲究繁多，一旦决定要认真学戏，那可不是一朝一夕的功夫。

即便像云堇这样颖悟绝伦的孩子也逃不了学戏的苦功。普通孩忍受不了压腿的疼痛、背韵书的无趣，然而小小的云堇却咬牙坚持了下来，还学得有模有样。

待到她出科时，「云翰社」里看云堇长大的老伶工们纷纷感慨：

「这下，璃月港要出个不得了的角儿咯。」

","switch":false,"is_show_switch":true,"without_border":false}

{"rich_text":"

「云翰社」里有许多老资历的伶工。早在云堇祖父当家时，就已是戏社的一员了。

云堇从祖父手中接过「云翰社」后，他们依然尽心尽力地协助云堇经营戏社。

老伶工们衷心热爱着自己的艺术，甚至可能热爱得过了头，在他们眼里，除了璃月戏，包括摇滚在内的其他音乐都是旁门左道。

云堇倒不这么认为。她非常欣赏摇滚乐中巨大的力量，甚至还和摇滚乐手辛焱成了好友。

排练剧目时，老伶工们都乐意听从云堇的指挥，但在生活中，年轻的云堇就像是他们的小孙女。

「乖乖啊，听话，辣的不能吃，对嗓子不好。肉可以吃，但不能吃多了，容易发胖。」

「实在想吃，就多吃点虾仁吧。那个什么…什么摇滚，不可以听，乱吼乱叫可不是好东西。」

云堇每每听完摇滚演出，回来都要被他们唠叨半天。

跟固执的老人讲道理实在太难，为了少受点罪，她只能想办法编借口。

听辛焱的演唱会或许不行，但去拜访范二爷家的养女「星燕」小姐，一起聊璃月戏，就没问题了。

老人们不怎么中意唱摇滚的辛焱，对范二爷家这位星燕的印象却好得很。

「星燕这个姑娘，听说又会绣花又会烹饪，准是个端庄大方的好孩子，我们云堇跟她玩在一起，还能学上几分，非常好啊。」

云堇早和范二爷商量过这事，统一了口径，所以不用担心，这个小小的谎言绝对不会穿帮！

","switch":false,"is_show_switch":true,"without_border":false}

人们对云堇有各种称呼。有喊她云老板的，有称她云先生的。

称她为云老板，是因为云堇乃「云翰社」当家。虽然杂务琐事有经理支撑，大事仍由云堇定夺。因此，许多商界人士爱称呼云堇为云老板。

云先生这个称呼，却有个故事。

云堇祖父管理「云翰社」那会儿，老戏迷都敬称他为云先生。等到云堇掌事，这些老戏迷也常来看她演出。

有位戏迷看云堇演得不错，散场后与人闲聊时，半开玩笑地说：

「现今这位『云先生』唱得也不错。」

人群中立刻出现了反对的声音：「年轻女子，也能称先生？」

这话被云堇听了去，轻轻笑道：

「先生于人的，年纪长，见闻自然广，大家当然称呼他为先生。」

「但见闻广博的人未必都很年长，况且女子怎么就不能有大见识了？」

「先生您快人快语，称得上先生，年轻女子答得上您的问，自然也配称一声先生才是。」

在场的戏迷们深感趣味，常挂在嘴边说道。最后，不论见没见过云堇本人的，都习惯性地随别人一起称她为云先生了。

","switch":false,"is_show_switch":true,"without_border":false}

{"rich_text":"

传统璃月戏中常见固定主题，讲述的大多是仙人或者岩王帝君本人的故事。

《神女劈观》之类戏，就属此类。因人们对仙人充满美好的想象，乐于观看舞台上的仙人如何颦笑，这类故事才能在璃月戏里占到大多数。

童年时，它们还能牵动云堇的心弦：但在演遍了仙人传奇之后，她的想法逐渐改变了。

为什么不试试其他的主题呢？比如…讲述我们自己的故事？

书写红尘中的冷暖悲欢，颂扬属于人的爱恨情仇。

或许这些凡人俗话算不上璃月戏的主流，却也未必不能被传唱。

爱执、贪嗔、痴念。人在或美好或悲壮的情感中确立心境，品味灵魂。

云堇不是仙人，不能设身处地体会仙人所思所想，对人的种种情感倒最是熟悉。

「那么，就来歌咏人本身的故事吧，用我的笔、我的嗓演绎天下人心。」

这是云堇心中从未对人言说的愿望。

云家祖上原本不以曲艺为业，而是专心从事武器锻造。

后来，也不知是哪位祖先腻烦了舞枪弄棍，反对戏曲产生了兴趣。总之传到云堇这一代时，家里再没几个亲自动手打铁的人了。

不过祖上倒是留下了不少物件，云堇身上这把铜锁就是其中之一。

她幼年练身段时，经常在大太阳下一站一整天。累到直接晕过去，这类事情也是发生过的。

父母疼惜云堇，可又明白基本功万万不可懈怠。

便默默拿出了这把锁配在云堇衣衫上，祈求铜锁锁住运势，护佑云堇平安健康。

直到长大，这把锁也从未离开过云堇。每次演出前，为了回忆那段辛苦又幸福的时光，她都会把它拿出来仔细擦拭。

神色温柔，像是在抚摸自己幼年学戏时那颗赤诚的初心。

","switch":false,"is_show_switch":true,"without_border":false}

{"rich_text":"

云堇初登台不久，经过大大小小几十场戏的磨砺，本就聪颖的她很快就掌握了舞台表演的要旨。

只要云堇亮相，绝对能赢来满堂喝彩。可这样唱得多了，反而觉得，这些不是自己想要的戏。

台上开演，每到矛盾激烈时就高声开嗓，每到形势陷入低谷时就放低声慢慢吟出唱词。

久而久之，对她而言，各类戏中角色都有着相似的面孔。

起调，摆一套漂亮的身段，再亮一亮她的好嗓音《神女劈观》中的神女和《连心珠》中的渔家小妹似乎也没什么分别。

观众或许能够接受，云堇却不甘于此。难道仅仅凭借演唱的技巧，仅仅依靠美丽的身姿，就能够讲述动人的故事吗？

带她走出瓶颈的，恰是《走雪》这出戏。

那是一出独角戏，演的是雪中的一段艰难跋涉。云堇第一次唱《走雪》时，天空中也飘着细雪。

戏中人在雪中迷失路途，茫然无措之余不禁哀叹起来。恍惚间，戏中的风雪与现实中的风雪交叠，茫然了许久的云堇也化作了迷途的旅人。

没错，正是这种感觉。她不仅是她自己，也是她表演过的千千万万个角色。

她务必像戏中人一样呼吸，生活，她的心情也随戏中人一颦一笑而牵动。

这千千万万个角色的生命轨迹交织，造就一个有情世界，这才是她想要的戏，她想讲述的故事。

在今天，云堇已经不记得自己顿悟后是如何回到后台的，她只记得，等到她终于得空脱去戏服时，她的袖中竟多了一枚神之眼。

角色

关于云堇…

刻晴

路过和裕茶馆的时候，如果发现被围得水泄不通，那一定就是云堇正在台上唱戏。许多商人都觉得，只是为了云堇，就值得把整个茶馆都买下来。

凝光

云堇啊…怎么样，你听得惯她的戏吗？起初可能是有些难懂，试着耐下性子多品味一下吧。我投资她的戏班不为别的，只是觉得，这般典雅的艺术，值得被一直传承下去。

行秋

云堇啊，她只要能喝到满意的饮品，就会有动力去创作新戏。我呢，就一直在床底下囤着一小罐茶叶，就是为了等哪天她兴致索然的时候给她送去。这样，我就有听不完的异侠传奇了！

辛焱

告诉你个小秘密，别到处乱讲哦。那个人可喜欢摇滚了，不管多忙，一周都来听我三场，只多不少。按理说，「和裕茶馆」的戏班头牌，该喜欢什么琴棋书画，花鸟虫鱼才对吧？肯定是平时被憋坏了，哈哈哈。

胡桃

云堇她在正式场合很优雅，私底下却非常容易亲近哦！上次我跟她打了个赌，输的人要用自己习惯的唱法唱对方填的词。哎呀呀，戏腔版的丘丘谣，你真该听一次！

申鹤

云堇唱的…叫做「璃月戏」吧？我很喜欢这种形式。不必亲见其面，就能了解他人的事迹。如果将来她把你唱进戏里，那一定会是非常精彩的故事，我很期待。

瑶瑶

云堇姐姐呀，她舞枪舞得可好啦，她表演的璃月戏也非常受欢迎，师父偶尔也会带我去看哦。只要有云堇姐姐登台，场面必是座无虚席，门不停宾…但、但…她唱的是什么意思呀？

嘉明

云堇大师是我榜样啊！不管内行外行，听过她的曲的都说好。真是不得了，什么时候「威水队」能做到「云翰社」一半的影响力…我做梦都会笑醒！

闲云

「璃月戏」有不少以仙人传说为蓝本的故事，其中也有以本仙的经历改编的戏曲…本仙当然未曾看过，看别人在台上演自己，难道不会尴尬吗？至于她以申鹤的经历创作的戏，待本仙空闲，倒是可以去品鉴一番。

主题：明月的传说…

发件人：云堇

时间：2026-05-21

可还记得当日与那位「白马仙人」共论的那首祈福诗「琅风·兹白」？

自那日起，我对天上明月的传说愈发萦怀于心，想乘着意兴速速谱一折新戏…

本已打好腹稿，可在翻阅诸多史册古籍后，我却生出另一番念想。

既是照彻天下人的明月，何不由天下人共同执笔？戏文中常说「千里共婵娟」。无论身处何方，抬首皆是同一轮明月。这一折戏，不该由我一人写就。

故而修书，想请你也添上一笔亮彩。哪怕只是寥寥数语，写下你某时某地见月时的心境便好。待此戏登台之日，你坐于台下一听便知，哪一折里，藏着你的故事。

届时，可要来捧场哦。

主题：异乡新感…

发件人：云堇

时间：2025-05-21

好朋友，你可知辛焱的演唱会已经开到枫丹去了？真替她高兴。

她的表演我向来一场都不愿落下，戏台那边已托韵宁打点妥当。我呢，这几日便权当在枫丹歇乏采风了。

在异国他乡做生日，新奇感触不少，切盼着与知音倾谈。辛焱算一个，你自然也不可或缺。

不如今日就由我做东，请你们到德波大饭店小聚一番。早就听闻枫达口感清新怡人，这回我也有幸尝尝滋味了。

主题：新戏的想法…

发件人：云堇

时间：2024-05-21

前些日子，我们戏社里两位乐师告老归乡，临走前他们介绍了几位新乐师来。

新乐师本领不俗，与我们磨合的时间虽短，却能做到曲与唱严丝合缝。听着那熟悉又新鲜的乐声，我偶尔会想起幼年咿咿呀呀学戏时，两位老乐师笑眯眯伴奏的样子。

生活中别离与相遇总在不断上演，怅然与惊喜，正是人生百味之一二。新的一岁，我愿与挚友多些相聚时光，也愿自己于戏艺上更有进步。正好近来心有所感，计划排一出新戏，趁着生日相聚，想请你参详参详，可一定要来啊。

主题：海上明月。

发件人：云堇

时间：2023-05-21

今年生日，老戏迷们包了船请我们全云翰社的人赏月。这是观众厚爱，我们自然要去。

我和大家商量了一番，觉得既然戏迷如此抬爱，我们至少得回馈大家一折好戏。

海上月下，风潮声中，唱这一折是最应景的：

「海岛冰轮初转腾，人生在世如欢梦，且自开怀饮几盅…」

能在生日这天和懂戏爱戏的朋友们留下美好的回忆，我由衷地感到幸福。

我希望这份回忆中也有你，但不知你是否有闲暇，因此写信相邀。

如果你愿意同我一道月下赏戏，就一起来吧。

主题：来吃些宵夜？

发件人：云堇

时间：2022-05-21

唱完今日的戏，心里难免觉得意犹末尽，想见见朋友。若你有空，我们晚些时候约在螭虎岩碰面，我带你一同逛逛夜市，再吃些宵夜，如何？

宵夜嘛，想来想去，还是烧烤配饮品才够酣畅。虽说和健康沾不上边，但看在是我生日的份上，戏社里的老一辈总不会再念叨了。一年能像这样放纵一回，想想也愉快不少。

这次还想请你喝喝璃月特色的大碗茶。若是觉得浓了、苦了，也不必勉强，尝个新鲜就是了。

到时见。
